images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one full-bleed landscape 16:9 photographic scene for a high-school AI literacy lesson, intended for 1280x720 video. Image 1 is a style, identity and location reference: preserve the same braided female student in the green jersey, warm wooden study room, and realistic, mature over-the-shoulder photography. This is a NEW summer-business planning scene, not Art Night. Change all Art Night materials.
The student is actively working on a summer business plan, looking between her notebook and a large computer monitor, one hand holding a pencil over the notebook and the other naturally at the keyboard. Her face is partly visible in profile, concentrating. The monitor and notebook together explain the activity. Notebook prominently says "Summer business" with three handwritten headings "Costs", "Pricing", "Customers", with a few rough planning marks but no invented financial numbers. A calculator and a small stack of planning papers belong naturally on the desk.
The monitor displays a restrained illustrative AI conversation, NOT a precise branded product screenshot. LARGE readable screen text only: header "AI assistant"; prompt "Help me plan a summer business."; response heading "Working through the plan"; three short lines "Estimate the costs", "Compare pricing options", "Work out customer targets". These are aspects being worked through, not guaranteed answers. No completion checkmarks, guarantees, numeric scores, brain or gears. Simple dark type on a soft white screen; much less text than a slide.
Composition: screen central/right and notebook fully visible in lower center; student left. Whole monitor and essential notebook headings inside generous 16:9 safe margins. Include enough of the student's engaged posture and hands to feel like an actual task, not a screenshot. Rich warm wood, believable skin and fabric textures, soft natural light and desk lamp. Match reference quality and warmth. No Art Night, floating icons, text banners, flowcharts, split-screen, collage, robots, watermark or decorative slogans. Return one landscape image.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one full-bleed landscape 16:9 photographic scene for a high-school AI literacy video. Image 1 is the style, identity and setting reference. Use the SAME braided female student in the green jersey and warm wooden study room, same monitor and desk, with mature realistic editorial photography. The task is now investigating college options, not Art Night.
A slightly elevated over-the-shoulder view shows her actively comparing two university information pages on the large monitor while marking a comparison notebook with a pencil. The readable notebook has title "Physics programs" and two column headings "Texas A&M" and "UT Austin". Row labels "Research", "Admissions", "Costs". Leave comparison cells mostly open or use a few neutral note strokes, no checkmarks or fabricated facts.
The monitor shows two clearly separate source-page panes with LARGE headings "Texas A&M" and "UT Austin", restrained campus photographs below their headings, and readable topic labels "Physics", "Undergraduate research" on both. A small but clear comparison workspace below or alongside is titled "Compare the sources" with short labels "Programs", "Opportunities", "Requirements". The purpose is visibly gathering and comparing information from different websites, not displaying finished claims. Make all essential headings legible in a 720p video; do not fill the image with tiny body text, URLs, fake statistics, rankings, prices or admissions data.
Two printed university information sheets with campus imagery on the desk connect the screen to tangible work. The student's hand with pencil rests on the comparison notebook; her other hand uses the mouse. Natural anatomy. Screen, notebook and university names stay fully inside safe margins. Warm library light, rich wood, detailed photographic surfaces. Same visual language as reference: a learner engaged in a specific, meaningful task. No Art Night material, unrelated objects, floating icons, globe diagrams, magnifying-glass symbols, external title/footer, collage, watermarks or slogans. Return one landscape photograph.

motion: 4% camera push, beginning after a 2-second wide hold, finishing 2 seconds before the end. No generated object animation.
